mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, COALESCE(s.total_count, 0) AS total_count, COALESCE(s.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(s.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(s.blocked_count, 0) AS blocked_count, COALESCE(s.not_run_count, 0) AS not_run_count FROM test_cycle c LEFT JOIN (SELECT cycle_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'NOT_RUN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_run_count FROM test_execution GROUP BY cycle_id) s ON s.cycle_id = c.id
mapper.select: WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY c.cycle_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_cycle (project_id, cycle_no, name, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cycle_no), 0) + 1 FROM test_cycle WHERE project_id = #{projectId}), #{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_cycle SET name = #{name}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_cycle SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_execution_history h JOIN test_execution e ON e.id = h.execution_id WHERE e.cycle_id = #{cycleId}
